channel.title: Regulatory Compliance Watch - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Regulatory Compliance Watch (regcompliancewatch.com)

item.title: Crypto asset activities subject of new FAQ
item.description: The new FAQ was added to 15 others relating to crypto asset activities and distributed ledger technology that the Trading and Markets division has posted over time

item.title: SEC Commissioner Uyeda supports retail investors in private funds
item.description: "It is not the government’s role to impose its judgment as to what opportunities investors may pursue, particularly when these choices are often being made by a fiduciary"

item.title: SEC Chairman Atkins delves into his vision, seeks to bring 'clarity'
item.description: "Advancing new regulatory frameworks means choosing a different approach. It means crafting rules that are clear enough to guide markets, flexible enough to accommodate innovation, and firm enough to protect investors. It is long past time that we do so"

item.title: SEC waives fines in valuation case
item.description: Federal regulators have agreed to waive fines against an accounting firm that missed multimillion dollar fraud warnings in a mutual fund it was auditing to reward the firm for cleaning up its shop

item.title: Private credit’s stress test
item.description: Whatever the recent runs on private credit cost economically, they’re already forcing the private funds industry to draw down precious political capital

item.title: Enforcement director quits suddenly
item.description: The SEC’s director of enforcement has stepped down after barely seven months on the job, sending a fresh jolt through an agency still finding its feet after a year of turmoil

item.title: DOL final rule: Update on the definition of an IA fiduciary under ERISA
item.description: The new final rule buries once and for all the DOL's new fiduciary duty definition following a recent federal court decision but restates ERISA Prohibited Transaction Exemption PTE 2020-02

item.title: Private funds: A look at the latest Form PF data
item.description: Private funds have had to report their sensitive data to the SEC on Form PF for 14 years now, but the reports may attract extra regulatory scrutiny given rising concerns about the private credit market

item.title: ERISA PTE 2020-02 (the rollover exemption)
item.description: This is a copy of the Labor Department's republishing of the so called rollover exemption, PTE 2020-02, that the DOL released in March 2026

item.title: SEC/CFTC crypto final rule and interpretation
item.description: The SEC and the CFTC have collaborated on this final rule that aims to provide regulatory guidance around the use of crypto assets and transactions involving them
